_comment: add-police. Stars added per witnessed crime; distances in metres, times in seconds.

officer_combat._comment: add-police-combat. A hit spends toughness by impact (kick: the fists' kick); it comes back after recover_s without hits. Spent, the officer is knocked down or tagged out as the mode data says (outcomes.officer). Seconds and metres.

helicopter._comment: update-police-pursuit: slower than a fast car (35 m/s is about 126 km/h; fast cars top out at 150-190), so it can be outrun in the open as well as lost under cover. shadow_*: a soft blob on the ground below it by day (no real-time shadow reaches 55 m up on the deck preset); it fades out with height between fade_from and fade_to, and by night_off it is gone (the searchlight shows where it is).

canopy._comment: update-police-pursuit: dense canopy hides the player from the helicopter. A tree counts when at least min_trees trees (itself included) stand within group_m; street-tree rows have about 3. The sight ray must pass min_depth_m through such crowns.
